description: This shell script checks for bugs related to ath10k and other hardware issues on an OpenWrt system. It collects system logs and crash data, organizes crash reports, and provides instructions for reporting bugs. The script includes functions for gathering system information, managing crash report directories, and examining debugfs entries for crash data related to ath10k firmware.

methods.name: bugcheck_generic
methods.description: Collects basic system info and logs for crash report.

methods.name: roll_crashes
methods.description: Manages crash report directories by rotating existing reports.
